meta.subject: zhuanye
meta.name: 外语专业知识
meta.description: 英语阅读与翻译（适用外交部、商务外语类岗位）

questions.stem:
【外语专业知识】Choose the best translation:
"Governance lies in addressing concerns."
options: A. 治政之道，在于安民
questions.explanation: addressing concerns 意指回应关切、安民。

questions.stem: 【外语专业知识】The phrase "due diligence" in finance means
questions.explanation: due diligence 译为尽职调查。

questions.stem: 【外语专业知识】"Notwithstanding" 在法律文本中通常表示
questions.explanation: notwithstanding = despite。

questions.stem: 【外语专业知识】Passive voice: "The policy was implemented." 强调
options: D. 政策被实施（动作承受者）
questions.explanation: 被动语态强调承受者或施动者省略。

questions.stem: 【外语专业知识】"Public procurement" refers to
options: B. 公开采购私人财产
questions.explanation: public procurement 即政府采购。
